official.retrieval: Public organization API backing the linked official guide; explicit picks/avoids only.

board-comments.retrieval: Public shared-guide API; candidate comments accepted as organization commentary at explicit owner direction. Explicit board-guide picks/avoids are accepted as BAMC positions at owner direction; conflicting guides are held.

catalog.retrieval: Public candidate/contest catalog used for exact labels, offices, seats and election date.

activist.retrieval: Public activist shared-guide API; full author name supplied by owner. Personal picks/avoids and comments are distinct from BAMC Action positions.

notes.N1547: BAMC Action is the owner-designated trusted Bay Area Muslim Council recommendation source. Support/opposition is copied from its official organization guide and owner-authorized board guide. Supplementary board-guide candidate comments are included at owner direction; they may concern local suitability or tactical voting and do not independently establish a Palestine position. Comment-only entries are not endorsements, neutrality ratings or opposition. Samir Laymoun is a separately attributed activist opinion source, not an official BAMC Action position. Comments are assigned to their reviewed candidate subjects, not automatically to the candidate under whose ballot option they were posted. Protest-vote support is marked as tactical. Propositions and ballot measures are excluded.
